ayahOccurrences.text: وَلَوْ أَرَادُوا۟ ٱلْخُرُوجَ لَأَعَدُّوا۟ لَهُۥ عُدَّةً وَلَٰكِن كَرِهَ ٱللَّهُ ٱنۢبِعَاثَهُمْ فَثَبَّطَهُمْ وَقِيلَ ٱقْعُدُوا۟ مَعَ ٱلْقَٰعِدِينَ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: وَلَوْ أَرَادُوا۟ ٱلْخُرُوجَ لَأَعَدُّوا۟ لَهُۥ عُدَّةً وَلَٰكِن كَرِهَ ٱللَّهُ ٱنۢبِعَاثَهُمْ فَثَبَّطَهُمْ وَقِيلَ ٱقْعُدُوا۟ مَعَ ٱلْقَٰعِدِينَ

lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: 3rd person masculine singular (form II) perfect verb
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: فَثَبَّطَهُمْ is in the derivative form: ثَبَّطَ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ث/ب/ط   th–b–ṭ to be slow, sluggish, phlegmatic; to cause someone to lose heart, to discourage, to turn away. Of this root, ثَبَّطَ thabbaṭa occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
ثَبَّطَ thabbaṭa [v. II, trans.] to frustrate, to discourage, to impede; to cause someone to be reticent

(9:46) وَلَكِنْ كَرِهَ اللَّهُ انْبِعَاثَهُمْ فَثَبَّطَهُمْ وَقِيلَ اقْعُدُوا مَعَ الْقَاعِدِينَ but God was averse to their going forth, so He discouraged them, and it was said, ‘Stay behind with the laggards.’
